selects.note: Console page + currency wiring unchanged; only /semantic-abi/ changed.

purpose: Fix the on-page 'type errors' (root cause: MOJIBAKE, not font tofu). The IPFS gateway serves /semantic-abi/ as text/html with NO charset and x-content-type-options: nosniff, so browsers fell back to Latin-1 and mangled every UTF-8 byte. The file was always valid UTF-8; fix is <meta charset="utf-8"> as the first element (overrides the missing HTTP header). Also added a viewport meta (mobile) and flipped the trustless-ai robot mark (scaleX(-1)) to face the title.
